summary: First-finish smoke test of ApexOdds crypto sportsbook. Backend auth + odds + bets + wallet endpoints respond 200. Frontend: landing loads with 35 ESPN events, login via header modal works, httpOnly cookie session persists (/api/auth/me returns admin), odds-button adds selection to bet slip (bet-slip-count=1), stake/payout/coin selection compute correctly (10 USDT @ 1.82 => 18.2 USDT), place-bet succeeds with 'Bet placed!' toast and balance debit, wallet deposit works (balance increments visible in header), bet history modal opens with open/won/lost filters, logout clears session, and placing a bet while logged out opens the auth modal instead of erroring.
passed: Frontend loads, odds-grid visible, sidebar sport filters present
Logged-in state: header-wallet-button + balance badge ($10,560 -> updates after bet/deposit)
odds-button-* click adds to bet slip, bet-slip-count increments to 1
header-wallet-button opens wallet-modal; deposit (USDT 100) submitted successfully
header-history-button opens history-modal; history-filter-open/won/lost all clickable
Logged-out place-bet attempt opens auth modal (does not error)
notes: Payment config UI (payment-config-toggle) lives inside the wallet modal rather than top-level; not retested here but main agent can verify. Bets remain 'open' because ESPN events are upcoming — expected per spec.
